verdict.rationale: Resend supports templating only via React Email (JSX components with variables, conditionals via JS logic), not a documented dedicated templating language like Handlebars/Liquid with merge fields syntax, and there's a separate 'Templates' feature mentioned only in a changelog snippet. No evidence of a documented preview/test-render workflow for templates before sending, beyond React Email's own local preview tooling. missing for 10: dedicated documented templating syntax with merge fields/conditionals/loops, first-party preview/test-render API or UI walkthrough, independent corroboration of the Templates feature.
